description: Every Yale academic tool YalieMCP had, plus offline course search, degree-audit history, and cross-source requirement matching no other Yale tool offers.

novel_features.name: Next-Course Recommender
novel_features.description: See which of your remaining degree requirements have the best-rated available courses, without cross-checking two tools by hand.

novel_features.name: Worksheet Schedule Conflict Checker
novel_features.description: Flags real time overlaps between courses already saved in a worksheet, before you find out the hard way.

novel_features.name: Worksheet Syllabus Search
novel_features.description: Search for a keyword or policy (e.g. 'no laptops', 'final exam') across every syllabus already fetched for your worksheet courses at once.

novel_features.name: Hypothetical Major Fit Checker
novel_features.description: Check how much of a major's requirements your existing course history already satisfies, without declaring it.

novel_features.name: Hypothetical Certificate Fit Checker
novel_features.description: Check how much of a certificate program's requirements your existing course history already satisfies, without declaring it.

novel_features.name: Canvas Course File Browser
novel_features.description: Browse a Canvas course's file directory (names, sizes, folders) without downloading anything — pick what's worth fetching before you fetch it.
